temporary_worker_scaleup.cause: Temporary fixture reservations plus overlap of terminating and replacement registry application pods during full-stack apply triggered the general worker autoscaler. The additional node hosted only DaemonSets; Gateway and fixture traffic stayed on the original nodes. Qualification guard stopped before disruptions.
temporary_worker_scaleup.remediation: Wait for automatic removal of idle worker, repeat qualification on four nodes; remove generator before Grafana test and both fixture workloads before final app apply.
